logic.text: The simulation script plots weighted Ea estimate standard deviation into figures/weighted_minus_unweighted.png instead of plotting the difference between weighted and unweighted regressions.
logic.note: The plan requires weighted_minus_unweighted.png to present the paired difference between the weighted and unweighted Arrhenius methods along with a reference line, but simulate.py plots the single-method weighted estimate standard deviation without differences or reference lines.
logic.fix: Compute the paired differences between weighted and unweighted Arrhenius regression results and plot them against noise with a reference line at zero.
logic.name: weighted_minus_unweighted.png

logic.text: abs_cov_slope_intercept_centered is measured on a diagonal matrix constructed with np.diag instead of computing the covariance matrix of the centered regression design.
logic.note: Constructing a diagonal matrix with np.diag forces the off-diagonal covariance to be identically zero by definition, so the returned check measure is a trivial constant rather than verifying the orthogonality of the centered design.
logic.fix: Compute the covariance matrix by inverting the centered normal equations design matrix and evaluate its off-diagonal entry.
logic.name: abs_cov_slope_intercept_centered
